proposal.summary: A specially crafted PDF with an excessively large page size can trigger a divide-by-zero error in Xpdf's text extraction code. The issue is related to CVE-2022-30524 but is caused by large page dimensions rather than large character coordinates.
proposal.cwe_quote: An excessively large PDF page size (found in fuzz testing, unlikely in normal PDF files) can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain a reproducer PDF or fuzz test case and run under a debugger to identify the vulnerable code path; then prepare a patch that checks page dimensions and avoids division by zero, and coordinate disclosure with the Xpdf maintainers.

This is related to CVE-2022-30524, but the problem here is caused by a very large page size, rather than by a very large character coordinate.
